headline: Approved a full Certificate of Compliance for the Malden River Works project at 356 Commercial Street.
summary: Amy Ball of Horsley Witten Group said the project is substantially complete, and the boathouse is still uncontracted. The city asked for completion by the end of September to close out a FEMA climate resiliency grant. Matt Burne asked that remaining straw wattles be removed before an October 4 ribbon-cutting.
decisions: Approved a full Certificate of Compliance for 356 Commercial Street (DEP File #210-102), with long-term maintenance conditions continuing, unanimously by roll call vote.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion was made to issue a full Certificate of Compliance under 310 CMR 10.059 for 356 Commercial Street (DEP File #210-102), noting General Conditions 19C through 19L (long-term Operation and Maintenance plan and inspection access) shall continue in perpetuity. Motion was seconded and approved unanimously via a roll call vote.
